Banner.Description: I specialize in building web applications end to end: Angular on the frontend, Node.js on the backend and the database behind them. Over %YEARS%+ years I've built platforms that fintech and healthtech teams rely on every day.
AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I'm a full-stack software engineer, and after %YEARS%+ years I still get a kick out of taking a messy business problem and making it feel simple on screen. Today I'm an Assistant Vice President at Delta Capita, working on software for the financial-services industry.

Before that I spent close to five years at CareMonitor running frontend engineering for healthcare platforms that patients and clinicians relied on. The UI team grew from 3 to 8 engineers along the way, and together we shipped Telehealth, e-Prescribing and Scheduling products used by 15K+ people.

I care most about the parts of software people only notice when they break, like a page that drags or a form a screen reader can't get through. I also like mentoring, and code reviews where both sides walk away knowing something new. Outside work I build websites for small businesses and keep a few side projects going.
